en-US.author: ADInstruments NZ Limited
en-US.description: The Blood FlowMeter Device Enabler is a software addition to LabChart, which supports the Blood FlowMeter hardware, which is manufactured by Oxford Optronix Ltd.
en-US.longDescription: The Blood FlowMeter Device Enabler is a software addition to LabChart, which supports the Blood FlowMeter hardware, which is manufactured by Oxford Optronix Ltd. for distribution by ADInstruments and for use with ADInstruments LabChart software. It allows measurements of blood cell perfusion levels in the microcirculatory beds of skin and other tissues.
en-US.name: ADInstruments Blood FlowMeter

zh-CN.description: Blood FlowMeter 设备启用器是 LabChart 的软件扩展组件，专为支持 Oxford Optronix Ltd. 生产的血流计硬件而设计。
zh-CN.longDescription: Blood FlowMeter 设备启用器是 LabChart 的软件扩展组件，专为支持 Oxford Optronix Ltd. 生产的血流计硬件而设计。该硬件由 ADInstruments 公司分销，需配合 ADInstruments LabChart 软件使用。该组件能够测量皮肤及其他组织微循环床中的血细胞灌注水平。
